reference.status: the contrast is matched to the ACCEPTED protocol-A reference; protocol B is not a dependency of it

task.target: all 321 channels over the full horizon, in the author's normalized space
task.scaler: the author's StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN rows only
task.reduction: the author's float32 MSE/MAE over windows x steps x channels

architecture.grouping: one branch over all 321 channels; grouping is held constant across the regimes
architecture.detector: 2 residual dilated causal Conv1D blocks, 16 filters, kernel 3, dilation 1, elu
architecture.core: Conv1D 16, kernel 3, causal, elu; read = last timestep
architecture.readout: Dense(96 x 321) reshaped, added to the last observation broadcast over the horizon

regimes.R0: from scratch: detector trainable from the shared random initial checkpoint
regimes.R1: pre-trained and frozen: detector weights imported and fixed; rest trainable
regimes.R2: pre-trained and adjustable: the same imported detector weights, adjusted with the full model

factorial.pairing: one auto-encoder per seed; R1 and R2 of a seed consume that seed's detector, R0 shares the seed's initial checkpoint
factorial.no_best_seed_choice: every seed is reported; no seed is selected by its score

pretraining.objective: masked reconstruction of the preprocessed input; the loss counts masked positions only
pretraining.internal_validation: a chronological tail of the outer TRAIN origins, separated from the AE's training origins by seq_len + pred_len
pretraining.decoder: a separate per-branch 1x1 Conv1D stack, saved apart, never connected at inference
pretraining.diagnostic_only: reconstruction error is never a result of the task

optimisation.checkpoint_rule: the outer validation selects the downstream forecasting checkpoint and nothing else
cost_readings: the auto-encoder plus the downstream fit
an equal-total-cost reading in which R0 receives the AE's budget as extra updates

exposure.outer_test: NO_ACCESS during any fit or selection
exposure.public_test_scoring: not performed by the pilot and not used to choose anything
